title: The Art of Deception
content_zh:
The Thirty-Six Stratagems is an ancient Chinese treatise
On the art of conflict, deception, and strategy.
Stratagem 1: Cross the sea under camouflage.
Hide your true intentions behind what appears routine.
Stratagem 2: Besiege Wei to rescue Zhao.
Avoid a direct confrontation. Strike where the enemy is weakest.
Stratagem 3: Kill with a borrowed knife.
Use a third party to attack your enemy.
Stratagem 4: Relax while the enemy exhausts himself.
Conserve energy while the enemy tires — then strike.
Stratagem 5: Loot a burning house.
When chaos strikes your enemy, move in.
Stratagem 6: Make a sound in the east, then strike in the west.
Feint one direction. Attack another.
